title: After eating
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said when his meal was cleared away
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaahi katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin walaa muwadda'in walaa mustaghnan 'anhu rabbanaa
translation: All praise is for Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise; [praise] that is never enough, never bid farewell to, and never done without, our Lord.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 5458: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/8163
